{{Nihongo|Gourmet|グルメマン|Gurume man|Gourmet Man}} is a character appearing in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]]''.

Gourmet judges the annual Cooking Festival that's held in the valley. He is only seen once a year and not much more is known about him.

Unlike some versions of Harvest Moon, he is not an eligible bachelor. You cannot give him gifts or befriend him.
